claims.quote: Known only from a series of small streams and tributaries exiting the Kanneliya Forest Reserve plus tributaries of the Opatha Ela (Opatha stream) near the village of the same name in southwestern Sri Lanka.

regions.name: Nilwala River
regions.quote: All known populations exist within the Nilwala River watershed, at least 70% of which is now cultivated and heavily mined for sand in some areas.
